title: CultureVidBench: Benchmarking Cultural Understanding in Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.01942v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models have advanced rapidly, yet their ability to represent diverse cultural contexts remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on perceptual quality, physical plausibility, and text-video alignment, but do not directly assess whether generated videos capture culturally specific objects, actions, rituals, visible text, or audio cues. We introduce CultureVidBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating cultural understanding in T2V generation. CultureVidBench contains 1,000 curated prompts covering 12 countries, 6 continents, 8 cultural regions, and 14 cultural aspects organized into three categories: material culture, social practice & performance, and ritual & ceremony. translated_title: CultureVidBench：文本生成视频中文化理解的基准测试
translated_abstract: 文本生成视频（T2V）模型发展迅速，但其表现多样化文化背景的能力仍未得到充分探索。现有基准主要关注感知质量、物理合理性和文本-视频对齐，但并未直接评估生成的视频是否捕捉到了文化特有的物体、动作、仪式、可见文本或音频线索。我们引入了CultureVidBench，这是一个用于评估T2V生成中文化理解的综合基准。CultureVidBench包含1000条精心设计的提示词，覆盖12个国家、6个大洲、8个文化区域，以及14个文化方面，这些方面被组织为三大类别：物质文化、社会实践与表演，以及仪式与典礼。CultureVidBench专为视频生成而设计，强调动态和多模态的文化表现，包括社会互动、仪式流程，以及文化上恰当的可见文本和音频。
tldr: CultureVidBench是一个全新的基准测试，通过覆盖12个国家、6大洲的1000条提示词，系统评估文本生成视频模型在物质文化、社会实践和仪式典礼等多个维度的文化理解能力，填补了现有基准无法直接评估文化表现力的空白。
en_tdlr: CultureVidBench is a new benchmark that systematically evaluates cultural understanding in text-to-video models using 1,000 prompts spanning 12 countries and 6 continents across material culture, social practices, and rituals, filling the gap in existing benchmarks that fail to directly assess cultural representation.
